view.stem: 光以固定频率从普通透明、均匀、各向同性的介质 1 入射到介质 2 的局部平面界面。两介质的绝对折射率为 $n_1,n_2>0$。有传播的折射光线时，$i,r$ 分别是入射角、折射角，均从界面法线量起。下列哪一项给出普遍适用的折射定律？

options.text: 入射光线、折射光线与法线在同一平面内，且 $n_1\cos i=n_2\cos r$。
入射光线、折射光线与法线在同一平面内，且 $n_1\sin i=n_2\sin r$。
入射光线、折射光线与法线在同一平面内，且 $n_2\sin i=n_1\sin r$。
入射光线、折射光线与法线在同一平面内，且 $n_1 i=n_2 r$，角度用弧度表示。

intent.task: Identify the complete geometrical and quantitative refraction law under explicitly visible ordinary fixed-frequency isotropic-interface conditions.
intent.source_solution: Boundary phase continuity equates tangential wave-vector components, giving n1 sin(i) = n2 sin(r); isotropy makes the incident ray, transmitted ray and normal coplanar. Angles are to the normal. Normal incidence gives i = r = 0; an impossible sine value means no propagating transmitted ray. These conditional results were solved before options in the frozen source-solutions.md, not copied from absent earlier definitions.
intent.unit_reason: Coplanarity and sine weighting jointly state one law, so one complete assertion is the response unit. This task is independent of the other seven definitions.
limitations: Recognition does not demonstrate independently writing or deriving the law.
Exact earlier definition wording is unavailable; the visible model excludes anisotropy, frequency change and evanescent-field analysis.

rationales.derivation: For angles to the normal the tangential component is proportional to sin, not cos; even normal incidence would demand n1 = n2 in this option.
rationales.misconception: Use the component along the normal in the boundary matching condition: replace each tangential n sin(angle) by n cos(angle).

rationales.derivation: Equal boundary-parallel phase components yield n1 sin(i) = n2 sin(r), and isotropic propagation lies in the incidence plane.
The index multiplying an angle belongs to that angle's medium. Swapping those factors reverses the refraction ratio for unequal indices and nonnormal incidence.
rationales.misconception: Start from sin(i)/sin(r) = n2/n1, reverse the ratio to n1/n2, then cross-multiply to n2 sin(i) = n1 sin(r).

rationales.derivation: Angles themselves are not the tangential components. The linear angle relation is at most a small-angle approximation, not the law for arbitrary allowed incidence.
rationales.misconception: Replace sin(i) and sin(r) by their radian arguments and promote that approximation to an exact universal relation.

view.stem: 在同一固定频率下，$c$ 是真空中的光速，$v_1,v_2$ 是两种普通透明、均匀、各向同性介质中的相速度，$n_1,n_2$ 是各自的绝对折射率。定义 $n_{21}$ 为光从介质 1 到介质 2 时，介质 2 相对于介质 1 的相对折射率。哪一组关系正确地区分这两种折射率？

options.text: $n_1=c/v_1,\quad n_2=c/v_2,\quad n_{21}=n_2=c/v_2$，与介质 1 无关。

intent.task: Distinguish the vacuum reference of absolute index from the ordered medium reference of relative index in one coherent result.
intent.source_solution: Absolute indices are n1 = c/v1 and n2 = c/v2 at the same frequency. With explicitly defined travel 1 to 2, n21 = n2/n1 = (c/v2)/(c/v1) = v1/v2. Reversing the media reciprocates the relative index. This is an independent conditional derivation; the seed does not supply earlier index notation.
intent.unit_reason: Reference medium and ratio direction are inseparable parts of the requested distinction; a paired formula set preserves them without one question per blank.
limitations: Selection does not assess an independently written comparison or ratio derivation.
Exact original earlier notation is absent; the relative-index order is defined visibly. Dispersion is not explored beyond the fixed-frequency condition.

rationales.derivation: Vacuum reference requires c divided by medium phase speed. Inverting both absolute indices also inverts the relative speed ratio.
rationales.misconception: Define each absolute index as medium speed divided by vacuum speed, then consistently divide those inverted indices as n2/n1.

rationales.derivation: The displayed relative ratio describes medium 1 relative to medium 2, opposite to the defined order.
rationales.misconception: Keep the absolute definitions but divide the incident-medium index by the receiving-medium index; substitute c/v to obtain v2/v1.

rationales.derivation: n21 equals n2 only when medium 1 has unit absolute index; the stem does not restrict medium 1 that way.
rationales.misconception: Replace the actual incident medium by vacuum without authorization, set n1 = 1 and omit the denominator in n2/n1.

rationales.derivation: Substituting n1 = c/v1 and n2 = c/v2 into n21 = n2/n1 cancels c and gives v1/v2.

view.stem: 固定频率的光从普通透明、均匀、各向同性的无吸收介质 1 射向介质 2 的平面界面，绝对折射率满足 $n_1>n_2>0$。入射角 $i$ 从法线量起，$0\le i<90^\circ$，$i_c$ 表示临界角。哪一项正确给出临界角及其两侧的光线情况？

options.text: $i_c=\arcsin(n_2/n_1)$；$i\lt i_c$ 时有传播的折射光线，$i=i_c$ 时折射方向沿界面，$i\gt i_c$ 时发生全反射。
$i_c=\arcsin(n_1/n_2)$；$i\lt i_c$ 时有传播的折射光线，$i=i_c$ 时折射方向沿界面，$i\gt i_c$ 时发生全反射。
$i_c=\arcsin(n_2/n_1)$；$i\lt i_c$ 时发生全反射，$i=i_c$ 时折射方向沿界面，$i\gt i_c$ 时有传播的折射光线。
$i_c=\arccos(n_2/n_1)$；$i\lt i_c$ 时有传播的折射光线，$i=i_c$ 时折射方向沿界面，$i\gt i_c$ 时发生全反射。

intent.task: Judge the ordered critical-angle formula together with the strict transmission/reflection threshold and equality case.
intent.source_solution: At the critical limit r = 90 degrees, Snell's law gives sin(ic) = n2/n1, so ic = arcsin(n2/n1). Below that incidence the transmitted angle is real; at equality its limiting direction is along the interface; above it no propagating transmitted ray exists and total internal reflection occurs. If n1 <= n2 there is no such sub-grazing threshold in travel 1 to 2, but that case is excluded visibly.
intent.unit_reason: The angle formula and threshold direction form one physical boundary judgment, not independent numeric and inequality blanks.
limitations: No numerical angle, calculation or independent written derivation is assessed.
The visible n1 > n2 lossless fixed-frequency model excludes absorbing media, wave-field details and frustrated total reflection; the reverse-index case is not assessed.
The seed lacks exact earlier definition wording; equality is described as a limiting direction rather than claimed to be incidence above threshold.

rationales.derivation: Set sin(r) = 1 in n1 sin(i) = n2 sin(r). Increasing i beyond arcsin(n2/n1) would require sin(r) > 1; decreasing it permits a real transmitted direction.
n1/n2 > 1 has no real arcsine here, so it cannot define a physical critical incidence.
rationales.misconception: At r = 90 degrees solve n1 sin(ic) = n2 by putting the indices in the opposite order, sin(ic) = n1/n2.

rationales.derivation: From sin(r) = (n1/n2) sin(i), the impossible sine occurs above the threshold, not below it.
rationales.misconception: Find the correct threshold value but reverse the inequality when deciding on which side sin(r) exceeds one.

rationales.derivation: arccos(n2/n1) is the complementary angle to the correct normal-measured threshold, not that threshold in general.
rationales.misconception: Measure the incidence from the surface, obtain 90 degrees minus the normal angle, then report that complementary angle as if it were measured from the normal.

view.stem: 在透镜两侧为同一种均匀介质的近轴几何光学成像模型中，$t$ 表示两折射面沿主轴的间隔。以下哪一项正确表达把透镜近似为薄透镜的几何条件及其结果？

options.text: 薄透镜的几何判据是 $t$ 相对于光的波长必须可忽略；忽略两个折射面的间隔不需要比较曲率半径和成像距离。
$t$ 相对于透镜直径足够小，就可把两个折射面的作用合并到一个透镜平面，而不必比较曲率半径和成像距离。
$t$ 相对于折射面的曲率半径及有关物距、像距可忽略，就可在该近似下把两个折射面的作用合并到一个透镜平面。
$t$ 相对于有关物距、像距可忽略，即使 $t$ 与折射面的曲率半径相当，也总能把两个折射面的作用合并到一个透镜平面。

intent.task: Identify scale-dependent neglect of axial refracting-surface separation and the single-plane paraxial approximation.
intent.source_solution: A thin-lens approximation neglects the axial separation t of its two refracting surfaces relative to relevant curvature and conjugate-distance scales, so the two refractions can be represented at one effective plane at that precision. Thinness is not a comparison solely with wavelength, diameter or absolute millimeters; no universal numerical cutoff is given by this seed. This is a conditional geometric explanation, not verbatim recovery of the missing earlier definition.
intent.unit_reason: The approximation criterion and what it permits form one complete definition judgment. It is not a test of individual dimensions as separate yes/no blanks.
limitations: Recognition cannot demonstrate independently explaining thinness or computing thick-lens principal planes.
Exact earlier wording and an error tolerance are absent; no numerical cutoff is invented. Paraxial and same-medium conditions are visible.

rationales.derivation: Thinness in a ray-imaging model concerns surface separation relative to geometric imaging scales; thickness may be much larger than wavelength while negligible on those scales. Sub-wavelength thickness is not a necessary thin-lens criterion.
rationales.misconception: Import the thin-film scale test t much less than wavelength as a necessary definition, then replace the geometric comparisons by that wave-optics criterion.

rationales.derivation: A diameter comparison alone does not control the curvature-dependent effects of separation or the relevant conjugate distances.
rationales.misconception: Interpret thin as a slender-looking shape, check only t divided by diameter, and omit curvature and conjugate scales from the approximation criterion.

rationales.derivation: Negligible axial separation on relevant curvature and imaging-distance scales allows collapse of the two surface refractions to one plane within the stipulated paraxial approximation.
Small separation relative to remote object and image distances does not eliminate separation terms when t is comparable to curvature radii; the unconditional single-plane claim is too strong.
rationales.misconception: Keep the object/image distance comparisons but delete the curvature-scale comparison, assuming distant conjugates alone make any lens thin.

view.stem: 在薄透镜、近轴近似中，透镜两侧为同一种均匀介质。入射侧和出射侧按当前光传播方向区分。关于透镜的主焦点，下列哪些陈述正确？

options.text: 对会聚透镜，平行于主轴的入射光线折射后实际会聚于出射侧主轴上的主焦点。
对会聚透镜或发散透镜，平行于主轴的入射光线折射后的光线或反向延长线都交于光心，因此光心就是主焦点。
对会聚透镜或发散透镜，任意有限物距的轴上物点所成的像都在主焦点，因此主焦点与物距无关。
对发散透镜，平行于主轴的入射光线折射后，其反向延长线交于入射侧主轴上的虚主焦点。

intent.task: Judge the real and virtual principal-focus definitions by the behavior of an axial parallel paraxial bundle.
intent.source_solution: A converging lens sends the axial parallel paraxial bundle to an actual intersection at the outgoing principal focus. For a diverging lens only backward extensions of emerging rays meet, at the incident-side virtual focus. Reversing incidence gives the other focus; equal surrounding media give equal focal-distance magnitudes in the thin model. The focus is neither the center nor every finite object's image. These focus definitions are independently derived because their earlier exact wording is absent.
intent.unit_reason: Real versus virtual intersection is one cross-type focus-definition judgment. A native multiple set captures it without per-word binary questions.
limitations: No diagram production or experimental focus location is assessed.
The visible thin, paraxial, same-medium model excludes aberrations and unequal-media focal distances.
No option assesses the opposite-incidence focus symmetry or equality of focal-distance magnitudes; the absent earlier wording is not reconstructed verbatim.

rationales.derivation: The defining parallel bundle for a converging lens actually meets at the outgoing axial focus; this is a real focus.
The optical-center straight-through rule concerns a centered incident ray, not the destination of a parallel axial bundle; a finite-power lens's focus is distinct from its center.
rationales.misconception: Take the optical center's special straight-through-ray role and assign it to the meeting point of every axial parallel bundle, conflating center and focus.

rationales.derivation: For a finite nonzero object distance, 1/f = 1/F - 1/d generally gives f different from F; the focus definition is the parallel/infinite-object limit.
rationales.misconception: Extend the infinite-object parallel-bundle conclusion f = F to all finite objects by silently dropping the nonzero 1/d term.

rationales.derivation: Emerging rays from the parallel bundle diverge, but their backward extensions meet on the incident side; this extension-only intersection is virtual.

view.stem: 薄透镜两侧为同一种均匀介质，采用近轴近似。$d$ 为带符号物距，$f$ 为带符号像距，$F$ 为带符号焦距，本题各距离均有限且非零。约定实物、实像、实焦距为正，其虚的对应量为负。关于透镜公式及这一约定，下列哪些陈述正确？

options.text: 带符号的关系 $\frac{1}{d}+\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{F}$ 可统一用于上述模型中的实物、虚物、实像和虚像情形。
不论物、像和焦点为实还是虚，用距离大小写出的 $\frac{1}{|d|}+\frac{1}{|f|}=\frac{1}{|F|}$ 都可保持各项为正。
像距未知时可写成 $\frac{1}{f}=\frac{1}{F}-\frac{1}{d}$；$1/f$ 项的系数为正，并不预先说明 $f$ 为正。
只要某点位于透镜出射侧并在那里实际发光，它就属于本约定中的虚物点，应取 $d<0$。
入射会聚光束若不被透镜改变，本来将到达的会聚点是虚物点，在本约定中取 $d<0$。

intent.task: Identify the unified signed thin-lens formula, distinguish a signed unknown from its algebraic coefficient, and interpret virtual objects correctly.
intent.source_solution: With the supplied notation and real-positive signs, 1/d + 1/f = 1/F. Real/virtual object, image and focus give respectively positive/negative d, f and F. Unknown signed f remains in +1/f; solving 1/f = 1/F - 1/d does not prejudge its sign or justify a second guessed sign. A virtual object is the prospective convergence point of the unaltered incident bundle, not a physical emitter at that point. Absolute magnitudes require case-dependent term signs.
intent.unit_reason: A single native multiple question judges the applicability and interpretation of one signed relation across its meaningful cases, including virtual objects and unknowns, rather than one binary question per sign.
limitations: Formula writing, independent derivation and numerical lens solving are not assessed.
The visible finite nonzero-distance model excludes infinite conjugates and zero-power limits.
The full sign convention is supplied visibly rather than tested as unaided recall; unknown d and F are not separately tested because the same signed-unknown rule applies.

rationales.derivation: Each signed reciprocal already carries the real/virtual sign; the given same-medium paraxial convention keeps the formula unchanged for those cases.

Replacing every signed distance by its magnitude removes required negative terms. A diverging lens with a real object and virtual image needs opposite object/image signs and a negative focal reciprocal.
rationales.misconception: Take the absolute value of each denominator independently, discard every associated real/virtual term sign and reuse the real-positive plus-plus equation for all cases.

rationales.derivation: Subtract 1/d from both sides of the signed formula. The coefficient of the unknown reciprocal is +1; a negative right side leads to f < 0, a virtual image.
A physical emitter is not made virtual by a fixed left/right location. Virtuality depends on the incident bundle's prospective convergence, not location alone.
rationales.misconception: Replace real/virtual classification by a fixed spatial side rule, then label an actual outgoing-side emitter a virtual object and assign a negative d.

rationales.derivation: The supplied definition identifies the unaltered incident bundle's future convergence point as virtual; its signed object distance is negative.

view.stem: 在两侧为同一种均匀介质的会聚薄透镜、近轴近似中，光从左向右传播，左、右主焦点分别位于入射侧、出射侧。作成像图时，下列哪些入射光线与出射光线的对应规则正确？

options.text: 平行于主轴的入射光线，折射后经过右侧主焦点。
平行于主轴的入射光线，折射后仍平行于主轴。
经过左侧主焦点的入射光线，折射后平行于主轴。
经过光心的入射光线，在薄透镜近似下沿原直线继续传播。
经过光心的入射光线，折射后总是改为经过右侧主焦点。

intent.task: Identify the useful complete ray mappings for constructing a converging thin lens's image in a visible fixed-direction paraxial model.
intent.source_solution: Parallel-to-axis incidence leaves through the outgoing/right focus; by reversibility incidence through the incoming/left focus leaves parallel to the axis; an optical-center ray continues straight in the thin approximation. Two suitable noncoincident rays from one point locate its image or the backward-extension virtual image; a third is a check, not compulsory. Diverging-lens focus-extension rules are not identical to the visibly narrowed converging rules.
intent.unit_reason: One native multiple set identifies a coherent construction toolkit, rather than per-ray yes/no questions. It remains independent of the focus-definition question because it includes reversibility and the center mapping needed for image construction.
limitations: Recognition of ray rules does not demonstrate drawing an image, choosing noncoincident rays in a given configuration or locating a virtual image.
The visible converging-lens narrowing omits diverging-lens construction and is not claimed as full-case coverage.
Exact earlier wording is absent. No source image exists; verbal rules need no new diagram, and figure delegation is not authorized.

rationales.derivation: The converging lens's outgoing principal focus is the real meeting point of the axial parallel paraxial bundle.
A finite-power converging lens redirects an off-axis parallel ray toward the outgoing focus; it does not preserve every such ray's parallel direction.
rationales.misconception: Apply the no-deflection behavior of the axial center ray to the entire parallel bundle, keeping its off-axis rays parallel after refraction.

rationales.derivation: Reverse the parallel-to-focus path for incidence from the opposite side; the left-focus incident ray must emerge parallel to the axis.
The same-medium thin paraxial approximation neglects lateral separation effects, giving the optical-center straight-through construction ray.
A general slanted optical-center ray preserves its original straight line, which need not intersect the right axial focus.
rationales.misconception: Assign the parallel-incidence focus rule to every center-crossing ray, replacing its unchanged line with a line aimed at the outgoing focus.

view.stem: 薄透镜两侧为同一种均匀介质，采用近轴近似。$d,f$ 分别为有限、非零的带符号物距、像距，按实为正、虚为负约定。$H>0$ 和 $h\ge0$ 分别是物与像的对应横向线性尺寸的大小，不使用带方向的高度。下列哪一项正确表达线放大率 $\Gamma$？

options.text: $\Gamma=H/h=|d|/|f|$；它是非负的物、像线性尺寸比，不表示像的正立或倒立。
$\Gamma=h/H=|f|/|d|$；它是非负的像、物线性尺寸比，不表示像的正立或倒立。
$\Gamma=h/H=-f/d$；它是带符号的像、物线性尺寸比，负值表示像倒立。
$\Gamma=(h/H)^2=(|f|/|d|)^2$；它是非负的像、物线性尺寸比，不表示像的正立或倒立。

intent.task: Identify the complete nonnegative image/object linear-size magnification definition and its relation to signed lens distances.
intent.source_solution: For size magnitudes H > 0 and h >= 0, Gamma = h/H. The optical-center ray and paraxial similar-triangle relation give Gamma = |f|/|d| >= 0. The signed transverse ratio -f/d uses oriented heights instead and must not replace this size definition. Squaring the scale gives an area ratio, not a linear ratio; reversing it gives object/image ratio. Gamma alone does not encode orientation.
intent.unit_reason: Size reference direction and the distance relation together define one magnification quantity. A coherent complete statement avoids detached ratio blanks.
limitations: No independent definition writing, triangle derivation or numerical size calculation is assessed.
Orientation construction, angular/longitudinal magnification and infinite conjugates are not covered; the visible quantity is explicitly a size magnitude.

rationales.derivation: Linear magnification is image size divided by object size; this is the reciprocal quantity, not the requested definition.
rationales.misconception: Reverse both numerator/denominator pairs in h/H = |f|/|d|, obtaining H/h = |d|/|f| and call it magnification.

rationales.derivation: The definition uses image/object size magnitudes; taking magnitudes in the paraxial center-ray triangle relation gives |f|/|d| and removes orientation information.
The supplied h and H are size magnitudes, so h/H is nonnegative. -f/d can be negative for a real inverted image and is the oriented-height ratio, not this size ratio.
rationales.misconception: Import signed transverse magnification -f/d while keeping h and H defined as unsigned sizes, then use the sign to encode inversion.

rationales.derivation: Squaring an image/object linear scale gives the corresponding area scale for similar shapes, not the defined linear magnification.
rationales.misconception: Use the area-scaling step on both sides of the correct linear-size equation and relabel the squared ratio as linear magnification.
